{{Quote|Victory in the Waymancy Storm has been celebrated every year since that solemn, glorious day 25 years removed. It will be remembered long after I have left office and long after all of our lives have passed into history.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
The '''25th anniversary''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] Victory in the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict was celebrated in [[7786 BBY]], on the thirtieth [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of that [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] tenth [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. On the occasion of that anniversary, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] delivered a commemorative speech.
